summary.vi: Recency, Frequency, Monetary, chấm điểm bằng NTILE, đặt tên phân khúc
summary.en: Recency, Frequency, Monetary, scoring with NTILE, naming segments

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
WITH rfm AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         CAST(julianday('2024-07-01') - julianday(MAX(purchase_date)) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
         COUNT(*)    AS frequency,
         SUM(amount) AS monetary
  FROM purchases
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT user_id, recency_days, frequency, monetary,
       NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS m_score
FROM rfm
ORDER BY monetary DESC, user_id
LIMIT 5;

prompt.vi: Tính RFM cho mỗi người dùng có đơn mua tại mốc 2024-07-01: user_id, recency_days (số ngày từ lần mua gần nhất), frequency (số đơn), monetary (tổng tiền). Lấy 5 người có monetary cao nhất, sắp xếp theo monetary giảm dần rồi user_id.
prompt.en: Compute RFM for each user with purchases as of 2024-07-01: user_id, recency_days (days since the latest purchase), frequency (number of orders), monetary (total spend). Take the 5 with the highest monetary, sorted by monetary descending then user_id.

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT user_id,
       CAST(julianday('2024-07-01') - julianday(MAX(purchase_date)) AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
       COUNT(*) AS frequency,
       SUM(amount) AS monetary
FROM purchases
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY monetary DESC, user_id
LIMIT 5;

prompt.vi: Chia người mua thành 3 nhóm theo tổng tiền (NTILE(3) ORDER BY monetary DESC, nhóm 1 = chi nhiều nhất) rồi đếm số người và tổng doanh thu mỗi nhóm: cột m_group, users, revenue; sắp xếp theo m_group.
prompt.en: Split buyers into 3 groups by total spend (NTILE(3) ORDER BY monetary DESC, group 1 = highest spenders) then count users and total revenue per group: columns m_group, users, revenue; sorted by m_group.

hint.vi: Tính monetary trong CTE, NTILE trong CTE thứ hai, rồi GROUP BY m_group.
hint.en: Compute monetary in a CTE, NTILE in a second CTE, then GROUP BY m_group.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT 1 AS m_group, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users FROM purchases;
